_comment: Real-world anchors for the throughput-realisation factor: the few public numbers that say how a production
fleet's realised token economics compare with benchmark peak. None of these refresh daily; each row is a
dated disclosure with a URL. They are shown next to the realisation dial so the factor can be judged against
evidence rather than taken on faith. Add a row when a lab or host discloses fleet-average throughput or an

anchors.name: DeepSeek V3/R1 inference system, 24h of production traffic on H800 (Feb 2025)
anchors.facts: Average 226.75 nodes (1,814 H800). 608B input tokens/day of which 56.3% hit the KV cache; 168B output tokens/day. Per decode node ~14.8k output tok/s (~1,850 per GPU); fleet-average across all GPUs and 24h ~1,070 output tok/s per GPU. Cost $87,072/day at $2/GPU-hr; theoretical revenue at R1 list $562,027/day (545% cost-profit margin), actual 'substantially lower' (free app, V3 priced lower, night discounts, nodes released to research at night).
anchors.implied: Fleet-average output throughput was ~58% of the decode-node rate; revenue at list ~6.5x GPU cost; realised revenue below that by an undisclosed margin.
anchors.computed_by_us: fleet-average per-GPU figure and the 6.5x ratio

anchors.name: Z.ai (Zhipu, HKEX 2513) H1 2026 interim results announcement
anchors.facts: Open platform and API revenue RMB 825m (86.5% of revenue; includes the Coding Plan subscriptions), gross margin 24.6% (-0.4% in H1 2025, 18.9% for FY2025); management attributes the rise to scale diluting fixed costs, price increases (average API selling price up ~101% since January) and inference engineering. Cost of sales RMB 702m, 'primarily attributable to the increase in computing service fees'. R&D RMB 2,131m, driven by model training. Inference served from 'a cluster of over 100,000 domestic chips', unit token inference cost down 80% since the start of 2026. Capex RMB 391m, mostly the Beijing Hongzuan asset purchase (RMB 360m of PP&E); PP&E RMB 855m at 30 June 2026.
anchors.implied: The margin is API revenue over rented inference compute: training compute sits in R&D and owned-hardware depreciation is still immaterial. 24.6% therefore means revenue of about 1.3x the serving rent, against the 1.1x the market-implied realisation factor assumes.

anchors.name: Z.ai (Zhipu) HKEX prospectus, Dec 2025: what sits in cost of revenue
anchors.facts: Cost of revenue H1 2025 RMB 95.5m: payroll 39.4%, 'computing service fee paid to providers of computing power' (third-party cloud) 37.6%, warranty 7.0%, D&A 2.2%, other 13.8%. R&D H1 2025 RMB 1,595m, of which computing service fees RMB 1,145m (71.8%). Cloud-based deployment gross margin 76.1% (2022), 31.0% (2023), 3.4% (2024), -0.4% (H1 2025). Compute bought under 1-4 year framework agreements; largest supplier in 2023-24 was the cloud subsidiary of a large Chinese internet company (RMB 395m in 2024). Flagship GLM-4.5 'open-sourced upon launch'.
anchors.implied: About 97% of Zhipu's compute spend sat in R&D (training), not cost of sales: the reported inference gross margin excludes training and, until 2026, any owned hardware.

anchors.name: MiniMax (HKEX 0100) H1 2026 interim results announcement
anchors.facts: Revenue $116.6m: Open Platform and enterprise $73.9m (63.4%), AI-native products $42.6m. Cost of sales $95.8m; gross margin 17.9% (12.1% in H1 2025), 'primarily driven by improving infrastructure efficiency'. No segment margins disclosed. Depreciation of PP&E $2.3m in total; R&D $296.9m 'mainly attributable to an increase in cloud services expenses related to training activities'. PP&E $74.9m (from $1.6m) and non-current prepayments $100.8m (from $0.9m), composition not explained. Alibaba Cloud purchases $75.9m in FY2025 and $75.6m in H1 2026; annual caps raised to $300m / $400m / $500m for 2026-28 (26 Aug 2026 announcement).
anchors.implied: If the consumer apps stayed near their 9M25 margin (~5%), the Open Platform earned roughly 25% in H1 2026, i.e. revenue about 1.3x rented inference compute, in line with Z.ai; the 60-70% API margins of 2024-25 did not survive the volume ramp and the flat-rate token plans.
anchors.computed_by_us: the implied Open Platform margin, (20.8 - 0.05 x 42.6) / 73.9

anchors.name: MiniMax HKEX prospectus, Dec 2025: what sits in cost of sales, margins by source
anchors.facts: 'Our cost of sales primarily consists of expenses associated with cloud services related to inference, as well as platform commission fees'; inference cloud = 95.0% (2023), 96.9% (2024), 92.7% (9M25) of cost of sales; 'cloud service expenses related to training are recognised under research and development expenses'. 'Light-asset business model, whereby critical computing infrastructure assets are owned and maintained by our suppliers ... without directly owning hardware assets'. Gross margin by source, 9M25: AI-native products 4.7% (-23.5% in 9M24), Open Platform and enterprise 69.4% (63.2% in FY2024, 75.1% in FY2023); blended 23.3%. Five largest suppliers (cloud and technology service providers) = 62.5% of purchases; Alibaba Cloud subsidiaries (Supplier J, a substantial shareholder) among them. M1 and M2 released as open-source models.
anchors.implied: At small scale (API revenue $15.4m in 9M25) the API line earned about 3x its inference rent; the blended margin is dragged down by consumer apps whose free users consume inference.

anchors.name: Anthropic compute cost per dollar of revenue (PitchBook via Yahoo Finance; reported, not disclosed)
anchors.facts: Reported $0.71 of computing power per dollar of revenue in Q1 2026, projected $0.56 in Q2 2026. Single-source press figure; Anthropic has not disclosed it.
anchors.implied: If accurate, revenue about 1.4-1.8x total compute cost (training included), i.e. the frontier premium over the commodity market's ~1.3x is real but far smaller than list-price arithmetic suggests.

anchors.name: InferenceX methodology note
anchors.facts: Benchmarks use random data with prefix caching disabled; results are 'baseline data and not completely representative of real-world inference' and do not capture under-utilisation or downtime.
anchors.implied: The published curves are a ceiling by construction.
